question:
Six persons P, S, T, Q, R, U sit around a circular table facing the center.
P sits opposite to S.
T sits to the immediate left of P.
Q sits opposite to T.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of S?
explanation: In a 6-person circle: P and S are opposite. T to the left of P. Its opposite position is held by Q. Moving clockwise/counter-clockwise from P, we see that the position to the right of S is indeed occupied by Q given the symmetry of the arrangement.

Q sits opposite to P.
V sits to the immediate left of Q.
U sits opposite to V.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of P?
explanation: In a 6-person circle: Q and P are opposite. V to the left of Q. Its opposite position is held by U. Moving clockwise/counter-clockwise from Q, we see that the position to the right of P is indeed occupied by U given the symmetry of the arrangement.

Statements:
All Scientists are Dancers. All Dancers are Doctors.

Conclusions:
I. Some Scientists are Doctors
II. Some Doctors are Dancers

Which conclusion logically follows?
choices: C) Both I and II follow
explanation: By transitive property, if all Scientists are Dancers and all Dancers are Doctors, then all Scientists are Doctors. This implies 'Some Scientists are Doctors' is true. Also, since all Dancers are Doctors, it follows that 'Some Doctors are Dancers'. Thus, both conclusions follow.
